It is a Faliro House Productions and Plays2place Productions film.  The film was nominated for 8 Hellenic Film Academy Awards, winning 2 : for Best Actor (Themis Panou) and Best Supporting Actress (Renni Pittaki).  It also won the Aluminum Horse for Best Script at the Stockholm International Film Festival.
